title: Stream Deck plugin manifest, as SuperDeck reads it
description: manifest.json in a <uuid>.sdPlugin directory. Lists the fields SuperDeck uses; others are allowed and ignored, since manifests are written for the official app. Image paths leave out the file extension. See sdk/protocol/README.md.

UUID.description: Plugin UUID, in reverse-DNS form. It must match the directory name; manifests without one take it from there.

Version.description: Plugin version, given to the plugin in its registration info.

Category.description: Heading of the plugin's group in the action list.

CodePath.description: Entry point. SuperDeck runs it with Node.js when there's a Nodejs section and it ends in .js, .mjs, or .cjs.

Version.description: Ignored: every plugin runs on Node.js 24 or newer.

Debug.description: "enabled", "break", or Node.js arguments; used only when plugin debugging is turned on.

MinimumVersion.description: Version of the official app the plugin needs; a newer one than SuperDeck reports gets a warning.

PropertyInspectorPath.description: Property inspector for actions that don't name their own.

DefaultWindowSize.description: Size of windows a property inspector opens, [width, height].

Profiles.description: Profiles the plugin ships, installed from .streamDeckProfile files (milestone M6).

path.description: A path inside the plugin directory, with / between parts.

Controllers.description: SuperDeck shows only actions for Keypad, the default.

DisableAutomaticStates.description: Don't toggle a two-state action when its key is released; the plugin calls setState itself.

state.description: How a state looks until the plugin or the user changes it.

FontSize.description: Some manifests write the size as a string.
